score.meaning: Strong implemented silence and attention-control craft, with clear sampled visual punctuation, held endings and deliberate replay. Below finished-signature quality because the phone composition breaks the authored direction of the question cue. This is a scoped source-and-rendered-frame score, not a rhythm/listening rating.

strengths.finding: The work is complete enough to function silently; silence is a valid designed baseline, not a missing soundtrack.
strengths.basis: Investigation PNG and decoded day/night sheets show antenna attention, glasses/consideration, then an outward held invitation. One-peek study reaches a half-eye reveal and retains it; the joke does not need an audible cue.

strengths.finding: Attention is returned after a bounded action.
strengths.basis: studio.js and signature.js initialize to still poses, play after deliberate controls, allow pause/scrub, pause when hidden/offscreen, and do not automatically resume. Engine completion clears playing and holds the final pose. Studio collection traversal is explicit, finite and cancelled offscreen even between clips.

strengths.finding: Reduced-motion preference preserves access to the intended content without imposing moving playback.
strengths.basis: Source selects the representative pose, removes movement in controls and disables collection traversal; interaction.json and description-and-reduced-motion.json record the still state and corresponding labels. This is source plus recorded browser evidence, not screen-reader speech or physical-device validation.

strengths.finding: Prior cue-suppression concern has a concrete implementation response.
strengths.basis: Engine._begin now skips the extra blend when starting at neutral; curious antenna-first opening is no longer mathematically eased twice. Decoded-day-0 shows its early changed antenna. I do not infer normal-speed perceptibility from the sheet.

strengths.finding: Motion has named causes and limited secondary accents.
strengths.basis: excited body descends through the 900 ms wing reversal, contacts at 1060 ms and gives the head a later recovery; the decoded hop sheet supports one rise-and-land cycle. The one-peek study removes a second checking beat without deleting the intentional character performance.

deductions.finding: Phone staging weakens the silent link between attention and its object.
deductions.severity: moderate; blocks a claim of fully resolved phone narrative staging
deductions.confidence: high for mismatch, medium for perceptual impact
deductions.basis: signature.css portrait rule places .question in row 1 and .moth in row 2; 390 day/night PNGs confirm the question substantially above the moth. investigationFrames still use gazeX 4–5 with gazeY -2 then 3 then 1 and a screen-right head turn. Those values were authored for the desktop question on the right. The pose can remain charming while its specific cause becomes spatially less exact.
deductions.deductionReason: Silent cause is central to this role; the viewer should not need sound or explanatory prose to repair a misplaced eye-line.

improvementCriteria: For the phone study, compare a question position intersecting the existing rightward investigation axis with a minimally retargeted portrait performance. Keep all tiny anatomy and light/dark numerical parity. Review actual moving portrait output before selecting.

Check unlabeled silent normal-speed play, replay and one interruption at intended size with fresh observers, particularly notice → consideration → invitation and when the action feels finished. Preserve owner preference as a separate input.
Resolve the unexplained live rAF gaps with a representative physical-device workload before a smoothness claim. Deterministic 30 fps export cannot supply that evidence.

If audio is later separately requested, begin default-off with explicit opt-in and easy mute, sparse event-based cues, no overlapping retriggers or catch-up bursts, and a repeated-listening comparison. No audio is required to improve this silent version.

confidence.overall: medium-high for scoped implementation and sampled staging

implementedAssessment.decision: Support the implemented local study and preservation of Investigate & share as owner-selected lead, with phone narrative staging expressly unfinished. Do not promote this to finished-phone, live-smoothness, audio or audience approval.
implementedAssessment.priorConcernResolution: Neutral-entry double easing has been removed in source; collection remains explicit and finite. Earlier concern about repeated catalogue timing is a future-site guardrail, not a new observed defect.

objections.finding: Do not claim the portrait signature has fully resolved silent cause-and-response staging while its question and authored gaze axes differ.
objections.doesNotBlock: Local study delivery with the limitation recorded; silent identity exports; further authorized implementation

limits: No continuous playback watched, heard, or subjectively experienced. Decoded contact sheets expose poses and sequence; they do not prove perceived pace or smoothness.
No audio asset or playback system was evaluated. No soundtrack recommendation is implied by the sound role.
No fresh unprimed human observers, repeat-visit study, listening test, recognition or attachment evidence.
Root owns browser; I did not operate one. Browser evidence records were read, not independently reproduced. No physical phone or spoken assistive-technology testing.
Desktop focused rAF evidence contains a roughly one-second maximum gap in both paused and playing observations; cause remains unestablished. No general performance verdict inferred.

skillsReviewed.appliedPurpose: Review relationships and stillness, challenge repeated attention demand, separate UI feedback from chosen character content, and explicitly bound what recorded frames can establish.

workflowChanges: Before future website motion work, make a small timeline naming lead (antenna/gaze/head), support (mitten/wing) and static elements (project copy, controls/background). Attach support to the cause or settle, not an arbitrary delay.
Keep a frequency inventory separating finite user-requested performances from navigation/control feedback. Retain static startup and indefinite settled rest; reject ambient replay by default.
Test cancellation during the between-clip timer as well as during a gesture; test hidden/offscreen behavior and replays from both settled and interrupted poses.

For the next shared review, capture the actual intended-size portrait action as well as the desktop one and identify the exact gaze/object relationship to inspect. Keep source facts, sampled-frame findings, continuous perception and human observations in separate fields.
If sound is ever commissioned, require a separate opt-in interaction and audio-specific repeated-listening review; do not infer consent from pressing a silent performance Play button.
